_comment: Qwen3 line frozen method (feature_QWEN, 2026-09-17). Same machine-readable freeze contract as frozen_method.json, separate file so the Llama line (R8-R10) stays untouched. Sources: CCM paper two-stage protocol (skip Step-1 for aligned instruct backbones, official README rule), RPBE hyper-params carried from the Llama line EXCEPT lambda_kf which must be recalibrated on the Qwen3 geometry (constants are never reused across hosts).
frozen_source: CCM official dialog protocol (max_steps 1000, lr 3e-4, accum-equivalent 128 effective cuts per window) + Llama-line RPBE structure (chain-wise multi-cut, gamma-only, window-matched cadence)

backbone.model: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (aligned instruct backbone: official Step-1 default-LoRA pretraining is SKIPPED per the CCM README rule)

adapter.lora_r_note: r=8 q/k/v/o conditional LoRA (trainable count 5,898,240, matches the port spec allowlist bit-for-bit; verified in the 4B smoke)

lambda_calibration.rule: r_eff = lambda * ||g_KF|| / ||g_task|| ~ 0.1, measured on theta_0 (calibration-only run, before ANY optimizer/scheduler step), calibrated once on the initial full window (training-only), then frozen for all seeds. GAMMA-scope measurement (R10 rule): r_eff is the gradient-norm ratio on the Gamma parameters only.
lambda_calibration.lambda_kf_note: RECALIBRATED on the CORRECTED theta_0 (merge s550, tokenizer-aligned comp-trainable geometry, 2026-09-18): r_eff_gamma(lambda=1)=8.794, derived lambda = 0.1/8.794 = 0.01137.  The bugged-geometry value 0.01507 (r_eff=6.635) is retired.

rpbe.z_v_source: J_mem(M_v) fixed adapter (TGN identity is its special case); GQA hosts lift the memory from the KV heads (8) with head_dim 128
rpbe.sketch_ensemble_note: Four independent 32-dim branches (J_ens = mean_r J_r); depth bucket b(L_v) modulates the future signature phi_r.

oas_shrinkage.rule: paired OAS covariance shrinkage per branch; the fixed ridge keeps only its numerical-safety role.

gamma.placement: one module per layer, shared across the K/V merges and the two COMP/SUM slots
gamma.zero_init: U0=0 zero-output projection init: R = U tanh(V [prev;cur;time(t)]) with U.weight exactly 0 and V small random. Step 0 residual is bit-for-bit zero (verified: max|dlogit|=0.0 on the 4B smoke).

window.collection: adaptive by effective cut count (dialogues with k>=4), not a mechanical microbatch count
window.cadence: identical task samples and scheduler cadence across the three arms

training.steps_note: Stage B (ours) budget = 60 windows (user ruling 2026-09-18: comp+RPBE joint fine-tuning from the Stage-A best checkpoint s550).  trainable = LoRA + COMP rows + Gamma (COMP rows STAY trainable in stage 2, task gradients keep refining them; RPBE touches Gamma only).  Sampling = q_L ∝ n_L + replay cap 12 (see sampling section).

official_protocol.data_stream: shuffled epoch loop (each dialogue exactly once per epoch)
official_protocol.micro_batch_note: equal-weight-per-dialogue normalization preserved bit-for-bit (row-wise mean CE / dialogue count); batch>1 is kernel-efficiency only

training.merge_cadence_note: window-matched applies to the RPBE-line arms (ours / gamma_task_only / ccm_merge under the depth protocol); the Stage-A official merge run uses the official fixed cadence via the ccm_merge_official arm
training.two_pass_replay: pass1 no-grad statistics forward, pass2 grad replay forward (RPBE arms only)
training.rpbe_gamma_only_note: R10 structure: the RPBE surrogate updates GAMMA ONLY — task CE keeps training LoRA/COMP/Gamma, the auxiliary gradient on non-Gamma params is discarded (dual backward, retain_graph).
training.rpbe_lr_note: independent AdamW base lr for the Gamma group (R10 formal config 5e-5); the shared cosine scheduler scales both groups by the same factor.
training.seeds_note: Qwen3 line starts with seed 0 only (user ruling, same as the R10 v5 line)
training.eval: matched-cohort depth curves on the clean test split (protocol C); primary metric = per-token NLL difference, EOS excluded
training.checkpoint_every_note: Stage B 100-window budget -> 10 checkpoints (s10..s100) + final, fine evaluation curve (user ruling 2026-09-17)
training.schedule_note: warmup/cosine over 1000 steps (warmup ratio 0.03): the 100-window Stage B runs inside the warmup-to-peak region of the original 1000-step schedule (same convention as the Llama line, where the e50 pilot kept the 1000-step schedule while stopping at 500).

sampling.q_alpha_note: q_L ∝ n_L^q_alpha.  q_alpha=1 (natural frequency) RETIRES the R10 inverse-sqrt upweighting (which gave the L=13 pool ~60% of the stream and replayed its 573 dialogues 52-120x each — turn_15 overfitting, diagnosed 2026-09-17).  With the replay cap, every depth pool exhausts its n_L x K budget at the SAME time, so the depth mix stays stable over the whole budget.
sampling.max_replays_note: per-dialogue exposure cap = official 12-epoch semantics (128k samples / 10546 dialogues).  A dialogue leaves its pool after K samples; exhausted depth layers drop out of the draw (q renormalizes over the remaining layers); when all layers are exhausted the counters reset for the next replay cycle.
sampling.rule: depth-stratified legal cuts with natural-frequency depth weights + per-dialogue replay cap; ONE original dialogue per window (tree_id = stable original dialogue id); L=1 dialogues carry task CE only.
sampling.paired_report: scripts/eval_ccm_paired.py (Llama line; Qwen3 line uses protocol C + protocol B curves)

freeze_host.scope: backbone + conditional LoRA + COMP/SUM embeddings all frozen (train Gamma ONLY); the trainer refuses the ours / gamma_task_only arms without --freeze-host
